div.div:
Notes:
- DM register window comes back from the axi_xbar DEBUG master port (port[2]) via soc_axi_to_dm.
- DM SBA goes back into the AXI fabric as the third initiator (AXI[2]) for memory loads.
- ndmreset_ack is generated in soc_top after rstgen brings core_init_ni high again.
- debug_req and ndmreset are routed around the DM slave/SBA blocks via the left channel between dm_top and the slave/SBA blocks so they don't cross other blocks.
